24697.commentary: (VINa) mayā idañ'c'idañ'ca gahitaṃ, idañ'c'idañ'ca na gahitan'ti evaṃ jānanto gahit'āgahitaṃ jānāti nāma.

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarapaṭiggāhakaṃ sammannituṃ, yo na chand'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dos'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na moh'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhay'āgatiṃ gaccheyya, gahit'āgahitañ'ca jāneyya. evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, sammannitabbo.
sen'āsanagāhāpako na sammannitabbo … gahit'āgahitaṃ na jānāti … sen'āsanagāhāpako sammannitabbo … gahit'āgahitaṃ jānāti ….

24698.grammar: pp of gaṇhāti, irreg form of gahita

examples.text: yaṃ eṇikūlasmiṃ janaṃ gahītaṃ, amocayī gayhakaṃ nīyamānaṃ, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.
gaṅgāya sotasmiṃ gahītanāvaṃ, luddena nāgena manussakamyā, pamocayittha balasā pasayha, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.
